selection.rule: Reject any configuration with a non-finite value or an unconverged Sinkhorn marginal at any step (post-quotient column TV error above marginal_tolerance, or a reset that did not run for the full horizon). Rank survivors by mean absolute error against the exact Kalman log-likelihood. Report the cheapest control setting whose mean error is within one standard error of the lowest, since differences inside that band are not statistically separated at this replication count.
selection.comparator: exact Kalman log-likelihood (model is linear Gaussian)
selection.selection_basis: cheapest control setting within one SE of the lowest mean absolute error

non_claims: The selected configuration is not claimed superior to other surviving configurations; differences within one standard error are not statistically separated at this replication count.
Passing the marginal-convergence veto does not establish posterior correctness, HMC readiness, or dense Sinkhorn equivalence.
This pilot covers dlgssm only. It is a warm-start candidate for no other model or route.
